# Spec: status-board
<!-- Generated by /hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-09-25 -->

## Overview
A `/hef.status` command that renders one management brief — where we are, per-epic completion
bars, what is at risk, a bottom line — from a source each project declares in
`.claude/project-status.json`: a **GitHub Project** board (today's batuta `scripts/project-status.sh`,
generalised) or a **tasks repository** whose columns are markdown files (fxcube's
`TODO.md`/`DOING.md`/`DONE.md`/`BACKLOG.md`). A helper, `hooks/status-board.sh`, does every
mechanical extraction with jq, git, and POSIX text tools only; the command adds the judgement.

## User Scenarios

### US1: Board from a GitHub Project [P1]
- **Given** a repo whose `.claude/project-status.json` has `"source": "github-project"` with
  `owner`, `project`, and an optional `roadmap` path, and `gh` is authenticated with `read:project`
- **When** the user runs `/hef.status`
- **Then** the helper prints the quarter header (from the roadmap, if present), the board status
  distribution, every epic (issues whose title starts with the configured `epic_prefix`, default
  `epic(`) with a completion bar from its sub-issue summary, and a bottom line — the same figures
  batuta's script prints today
- **Edge:** the project has an epic with no sub-issues → the row reads `no tasks yet`, bar empty
- **Error:** the token lacks `read:project` → `--check` names that prerequisite and its one-line
  fix; the run exits non-zero with nothing on stdout
- Files: `hooks/status-board.sh`, `commands/hef.status.md`, `tests/smoke.sh`

### US2: Board from a tasks repository [P1]
- **Given** `.claude/project-status.json` has `"source": "tasks-repo"` with a `root`, the four
  column files, an `item_heading` pattern, an `id_pattern`, and a `done_section` pattern with a
  date capture
- **When** the user runs `/hef.status`
- **Then** the helper prints, per column, the number of items (headings that match `item_heading`
  and contain an id) and the distribution of their leading sub-state marker (e.g. 📥 🔧 🧪 ✅);
  the count of DONE sections dated inside the current quarter; days left in the quarter; and a
  bottom line
- **Edge:** a heading matches `item_heading` but carries no id (a lane or wave title) → it is not
  counted as an item; a DONE section dated in a previous quarter → not counted as delivered this
  quarter
- **Error:** a configured column file is missing → the helper exits non-zero naming the path;
  nothing on stdout
- Files: `hooks/status-board.sh`, `tests/smoke.sh`

### US3: Epics from initiative scoreboards [P1]
- **Given** a tasks-repo config with `"epics": {"initiatives": "initiatives/*.md"}` and files
  whose items carry ids with one dominant prefix (e.g. `PERF-24…PERF-73`)
- **When** `/hef.status` runs
- **Then** each initiative file is one epic: total = distinct ids with the file's dominant prefix,
  completed = ids that appear struck through (`~~ID~~`) or on a line carrying ✅, rendered as a
  completion bar with `completed/total (pct)`
- **Edge:** an initiative file with ids but no completion marks → `0/N (0%)`, not an error
- **Error:** the glob matches nothing → the epics section says `no initiatives found`, exit 0
  (an empty set is an answer, not a failure)
- Files: `hooks/status-board.sh`, `tests/smoke.sh`

### US4: Spec checkboxes only when the project opts in [P2]
- **Given** a tasks-repo config with `"epics": {"specs": true}` and a `.specify/specs/*/tasks.md`
  set under `root`
- **When** `/hef.status` runs
- **Then** each spec directory is an epic with `ticked/total` tasks as its completion
- **Given** `"specs": false` or the key absent
- **Then** spec directories are not read at all — because in fxcube 48 of 63 shipped specs still
  show open boxes and would report a product in production as 23 % delivered
- Files: `hooks/status-board.sh`, `tests/smoke.sh`

### US5: Prerequisites diagnosed, never guessed [P1]
- **Given** any configured source
- **When** the user runs `/hef.status --check` (helper `--check`)
- **Then** the helper prints a `[ok]` / `[MISSING]` checklist of every prerequisite for that
  source (config present and valid, jq, and for github-project: gh, auth, project readable) with a
  one-line fix per missing item, exit 0 when all met, 1 otherwise
- **Error:** no `.claude/project-status.json` → the helper exits non-zero, stderr shows a minimal
  example for each source; stdout empty (constitution 5: a fetcher that cannot fetch fails loudly)
- Files: `hooks/status-board.sh`, `commands/hef.status.md`

### US6: Task-level drill-down [P2]
- **Given** a github-project source
- **When** the user runs `/hef.status --detailed`
- **Then** each epic is unfolded into its sub-issues with open/closed marker, board phase, assignee,
  and title (batuta's `--detailed`)
- **Given** a tasks-repo source
- **Then** `--detailed` lists each column's items (id, sub-state, title) under the column
- Files: `hooks/status-board.sh`, `commands/hef.status.md`

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | `hooks/status-board.sh` reads `.claude/project-status.json` from the repo root (or `--config <path>`) and selects the source from its `source` field; an unknown source exits non-zero with the accepted values on stderr | P1 | US5 |
| FR-002 | With no config file the helper exits non-zero, prints nothing on stdout, and prints a minimal example config for each source on stderr | P1 | US5 |
| FR-003 | `--check` prints a per-prerequisite `[ok]`/`[MISSING]` checklist for the configured source with a one-line fix per missing item; exit 0 only when all are met | P1 | US5 |
| FR-004 | github-project: the board status distribution, epic discovery by `epic_prefix` across every repo on the project, per-epic sub-issue completion bars, roadmap quarter header and days left, and the bottom line match `scripts/project-status.sh` for the same project | P1 | US1 |
| FR-005 | github-project `--detailed` unfolds each epic into its sub-issues with marker, board phase, assignee, and title | P2 | US6 |
| FR-006 | tasks-repo: an item is a heading matching `item_heading` whose text contains a match of `id_pattern`; headings without an id are not items | P1 | US2 |
| FR-007 | tasks-repo: per column, the item count and the distribution of leading sub-state markers — the heading's first token when it is neither the id nor an ordinary word (a token starting with a letter, digit, `*`, `_`, backtick, `[` or `(` is text, not a marker; markers are emoji/symbols) | P1 | US2 |
| FR-008 | tasks-repo: delivered-this-quarter = DONE sections whose `done_section` date capture falls in the current calendar quarter (or the quarter declared by `quarter_start`/`quarter_end` in the config); days left is computed from the quarter end | P1 | US2 |
| FR-009 | tasks-repo: each file matched by `epics.initiatives` is an epic whose total is the distinct ids sharing the file's dominant prefix and whose completed count is ids struck through or on a ✅ line | P1 | US3 |
| FR-010 | tasks-repo: spec directories contribute epics (`ticked/total` from `tasks.md`) only when `epics.specs` is `true`; otherwise they are not read | P2 | US4 |
| FR-011 | A missing configured column file exits non-zero naming the path, with nothing on stdout | P1 | US2 |
| FR-012 | tasks-repo `--detailed` lists each column's items with id, sub-state, and title | P2 | US6 |
| FR-013 | `commands/hef.status.md` runs the helper with the Bash tool, presents the four sections (where we are, by epic, at risk, bottom line), cites only the helper's numbers, and on helper failure reports `--check`'s findings and stops | P1 | US1, US2 |
| FR-014 | The helper needs only jq, git, and POSIX text tools for tasks-repo, plus `gh` for github-project; no install step (constitution 4) | P1 | US5 |
| FR-015 | Smoke fixtures drive tasks-repo end to end on a temp kanban (items with and without ids, dated DONE sections in and out of quarter, an initiative file with struck and unstruck ids, a spec with mixed boxes) and github-project on a stubbed `gh` recording its calls; each guard mutation-checked | P1 | US2, US3, US4 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | On batuta-agent-v2 the github-project board prints the same totals, epic bars, and bottom line as `make project-status` | Run both, diff the numeric fields |
| SC-002 | On fxcube/tasks the tasks-repo board prints item counts per column equal to a hand count of id-bearing headings, and DONE-this-quarter equal to the count of dated sections since the quarter start | Hand count vs helper output |
| SC-003 | `--check` with a token lacking `read:project` names exactly that and the fix | Run under a scoped-down token |
| SC-004 | Every FR is cited by at least one smoke check (`req-coverage`) | `/hef.verify` |
| SC-005 | Each new guard goes red under its mutation | Mutation pass recorded in the smoke comments |

## Clarifications
_Resolved 2026-09-25 (user decisions):_
- Sub-state markers are reported **as found** (the leading emoji of an item heading); when the config
  carries a `states` map (marker → label) the board prints the label instead. Unknown markers are
  reported as-is, never an error.
- The tasks-repo quarter is **today's calendar quarter** unless the config sets `quarter_start` /
  `quarter_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), which override it; setting only one of them is a config error (fail loudly).
- Sub-state markers: a heading's first token counts as a marker only when it is not the id and not
  an ordinary word (letter, digit, `*`, `_`, backtick, `[`, `(` initial). Emoji and symbols are markers.
